english: Let $S$ be the set of all $\theta\in(0,\pi)$ for which the system of equations
has a non-trivial solution. Then the value of $\dfrac{1}{\pi}\displaystyle\sum_{\theta\in S}\theta$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $S$, $(0,\pi)$ में उन सभी $\theta$ का समुच्चय है जिनके लिए समीकरण निकाय
का एक अतुच्छ (non-trivial) हल है। तब $\dfrac{1}{\pi}\displaystyle\sum_{\theta\in S}\theta$ का मान ______ है।
solution_full: A homogeneous system has a non-trivial solution exactly when its coefficient determinant is zero.

General solution: $\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}=n\pi+(-1)^{n}\frac{\pi}{4}$, i.e. $\theta=2m\pi$ (even $n$) or $\theta=(2m+1)\pi-\frac{\pi}{2}=2m\pi+\frac{\pi}{2}$ (odd $n$). In the open interval $(0,\pi)$ only $\theta=\frac{\pi}{2}$; $\theta=0$ is excluded.
Check $\theta=\frac{\pi}{2}$: the equations become $x+z=0$, $y+z=0$, $x+y+2z=0$, satisfied by $(1,1,-1)$.
originality_note: New: a homogeneous system with swapped sin and cos in two rows, whose determinant factors as (sin - cos)(sin + cos - 1), so two different general-solution families must be intersected with an open interval (way 5). Closest known: the IIT problem (sin 3 theta) x - y + z = 0, (cos 2 theta) x + 4y + 3z = 0, 2x + 7y + 7z = 0. Different because: the factorisation and both families are new, and the end point theta = 0 of one family must be excluded.
blueprint_concepts: Solving system of homogeneous linear equations
General solution of sin(x) = k, cos(x) = k, tan(x) = k

concept_use.Solving system of homogeneous linear equ: Non-trivial solutions exist iff the coefficient determinant 2(sin - cos)(sin + cos - 1) vanishes.
concept_use.General solution of sin(x) = k, cos(x) =: The general solutions of tan theta = 1 and sin(theta + pi/4) = 1/sqrt 2 give the members of S in (0, pi).

stem_review: Read as a student: S is a subset of the open interval (0, pi), so theta = 0 is excluded; the sum is over a finite set. Checked the factorisation with sympy and the roots numerically: pi/4 and pi/2 only. Answer 0.75, a decimal between 0 and 1 as planned. Changed: No change.
key_step: Factor the determinant into (sin - cos)(sin + cos - 1) and solve both families in (0, pi).
justification: Two linked ideas (factorising a trigonometric determinant, and general solutions of two equations with an excluded end point); numerical answer. Comparable to 2023-P2-Q3 (L3) and 2025-P2-Q3 (L3).
